title: Sensors and Actuators
subtitle: Reading temperature, controlling motors, and PWM

content.text: Sensors convert physical quantities to electrical signals. The DHT22 gives temperature and humidity; HC-SR04 measures distance with ultrasound.
PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) simulates analog output by rapidly switching a digital pin on and off.

questions.question: What is PWM used for?
options: Simulating analog output by varying pulse duty cycle
questions.explanation: PWM rapidly switches a pin on and off to simulate an analog voltage, controlling LED brightness, motor speed, and servo position.

faq.q: How do I debounce a button?
faq.a: Add a small delay (5-20 ms) after detecting a state change, or use the Bounce2 library to handle mechanical switch bouncing reliably.
